stem: How does the author establish that Maud is a character foil for Frank in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy?

options.label: A
options.text: Maud is more curious about the Ferris wheel, while Frank is more interested in the Kinetoscope.

options.label: B
options.text: Maud is always hurrying, while Frank prefers to take his time viewing all the exhibits.

options.label: C
options.text: Maud has more knowledge about the Kinetoscope, while Frank is more knowledgeable about the Ferris wheel.

options.label: D
options.text: Maud has a more practical view of the world, while Frank is more imaginative.
